duel.title: The Duel
duel.tagline: Write a piece. Then send its words against the one Sappho has already written.
duel.rule_1: Sappho has written her piece for today's prompt. Nobody can read it yet.
duel.rule_2: Write your own piece, then send some of its words against hers. A word she used is a hit (+1). A word she did not use is a miss (−1).
duel.rule_3: Then she rewrites her piece without a single word you sent.
duel.note: Small words — the, and, to be — never count. Only words of four letters or more.
duel.signin: Sign in to play today's duel.
duel.prepare_failed: Sappho could not write today. Try again in a little while.
duel.unavailable: The duel is not open right now. Come back a little later.
duel.placeholder: Write here, in your own words…
duel.too_short: Write at least {n} words before you send any.
duel.too_long: Keep it to {n} words or fewer.
duel.choose_body: Pick words from your own piece to forbid her. The slider picks the first ones; tap a word to add it or take it back. Nothing is sent until you lock in.
duel.lock_hint: This sends them and locks today’s duel. It cannot be undone.
duel.locked_notice: Locked. Come back tomorrow for a new duel.
